invariants.rationale: HoodieJavaTable.create(config, context) should always return a non-null instance as a factory method.
A valid config is required to create a HoodieTable.
A valid context is required to create a HoodieTable.
HoodieJavaTable.create returns a HoodieTable or subclass.
By construction, the method always returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create(config, context).
